# C&A Digitals

> A two-person web studio (Chris and Adam). We design, build and look after websites for small businesses across the US, fully remote, from Florida and Prague.

## Services
- Website design & build: custom sites, fast on phones, launched on the client's own domain; moving old sites without losing Google rankings, old links or email
- Google Business Profile & maps: Google, Apple Maps, Bing, Yelp and TripAdvisor with the same details everywhere
- Reviews: short review link and print-ready QR cards
- Bookings, payments & gift cards: call/text/WhatsApp buttons, spam-protected forms, online bookings, Stripe payments and gift cards (accounts stay in the client's name)
- Other language versions: Spanish, Portuguese, French and more, checked by a native speaker
- Accessibility (ADA): checking and fixing sites for screen readers, keyboards and large text
- Monthly care: hosting, backups, small edits and a monthly report
- Also: owner-editable sites, AI search visibility, photo and video polish, logo and brand basics, domain and business email (always in the client's name)

## Packages
- Starter: custom website, Google Business Profile, call/text and contact form
- Growth: Starter plus reviews kit, bookings and payments, one extra language
- Care: hosting, backups, small edits and a monthly report; add to either package

## How we work
Everything is remote: a 20-minute phone call, a short questionnaire and shared folder, a private preview link, two or three rounds of feedback, then launch with a short how-to video and ongoing care.
